title: Learning Curve and Interface Complexity
summary: This topic centers on customers saying the vehicle takes time to learn, with a few explicit complaints that the software and display interface feel overly complex or distracting.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the UI and display controls as too complicated, insufficiently simplified, and distracting to navigate while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state that owners still need time or guidance to learn vehicle features, with examples ranging from general familiarization to specific functions like opening the hood or adjusting IPA behavior.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined statements about learning needs rather than clear evaluations, which limits firm sentiment conclusions.
The cluster mixes general learning-curve comments with unrelated specific needs such as knee cushioning, so it is not fully coherent as a single issue.
Examples are limited to the supplied fragments and are not representative estimates of the broader owner population.
